title: Lenny runtime lifecycle events
description: JSON envelopes exchanged on the §4.7 adapter↔runtime lifecycle channel, a Unix socket distinct from the stdin/stdout JSONL message channel (schemas/lenny-adapter-jsonl.schema.json). Field names are camelCase to match the §4.7 message-schema table and the adapter wire (pkg/adapter/lifecyclechannel.go). The task_complete, task_ready, and task_complete_acknowledged envelopes here are the intra-pod task-lifecycle signals; the same-named envelopes in the JSONL schema are the separate adapter→gateway control surface. See spec/04_system-components.md §4.7 and spec/15_external-api-surface.md §15.4.

lifecycle_capabilities.title: lifecycle_capabilities
lifecycle_capabilities.description: Adapter → runtime, first message after the lifecycle channel opens. Advertises the lifecycle capabilities the adapter supports for this session. The runtime replies with lifecycle_support. task_lifecycle is offered only on task-mode pods.

lifecycle_support.title: lifecycle_support
lifecycle_support.description: Runtime → adapter, reply to lifecycle_capabilities. The runtime declares the subset of advertised capabilities it implements.

checkpoint_request.title: checkpoint_request
checkpoint_request.description: Adapter → runtime. Asks the runtime to quiesce so the adapter can take a consistent snapshot. The runtime must reply with checkpoint_ready within deadlineMs.

checkpoint_ready.title: checkpoint_ready
checkpoint_ready.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime has quiesced and is ready for the snapshot.

checkpoint_complete.title: checkpoint_complete
checkpoint_complete.description: Adapter → runtime. Confirms the snapshot upload result and releases the runtime from quiescence. reason is present when status is failed.

interrupt_request.title: interrupt_request
interrupt_request.description: Adapter → runtime. Asks the runtime to reach a safe stop point and acknowledge with interrupt_acknowledged within deadlineMs.

interrupt_acknowledged.title: interrupt_acknowledged
interrupt_acknowledged.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime has reached a safe stop point. The original interruptId is echoed.

credentials_rotated.title: credentials_rotated
credentials_rotated.description: Adapter → runtime. New credentials have been written to credentialsPath. The runtime must rebind and reply with credentials_acknowledged.

credentials_acknowledged.title: credentials_acknowledged
credentials_acknowledged.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime has rebound to the new credential. The adapter releases queued LLM requests with the new credential.

deadline_approaching.title: deadline_approaching
deadline_approaching.description: Adapter → runtime. Advance warning before forced termination. remainingMs is the time left until session expiry or budget exhaustion.

terminate.title: terminate
terminate.description: Adapter → runtime. Graceful shutdown signal. The runtime must exit within deadlineMs; the adapter sends SIGTERM on timeout. Always means process exit, never between-task signaling.

task_complete.title: task_complete
task_complete.description: Adapter → runtime, task-mode lifecycle signal. The current task is finished; the runtime releases task-specific resources and replies with task_complete_acknowledged. The runtime does not exit.

task_ready.title: task_ready
task_ready.description: Adapter → runtime, task-mode lifecycle signal. Sent after scrub completes and the new workspace is materialized. The runtime re-reads the adapter manifest and prepares for the next message.

task_complete_acknowledged.title: task_complete_acknowledged
task_complete_acknowledged.description: Runtime → adapter, reply to task_complete. The runtime has released task-specific resources and is ready for scrub.

llm_request_started.title: llm_request_started
llm_request_started.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime is about to send an outbound LLM request directly to the provider (direct mode). The adapter increments the in-flight counter for this provider.

llm_request_completed.title: llm_request_completed
llm_request_completed.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime's outbound LLM request has completed or errored. The adapter decrements the in-flight counter; when it reaches zero and a rotation is pending, the adapter sends credentials_rotated.
